Industry Minister Mélanie Joly is set to hold a four-way meeting Thursday with automaker Stellantis, the union representing its more than 9,000 workers in Canada, and representatives of the Ontario government, The Canadian Press reports.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned Thursday after his extramarital affair raised national security concerns, in a spectacular downfall for the longtime head of the chipmaker, a vital player in the artificial intelligence boom, The Canadian Press reports.
Washington DC shooting: suspect confirmed dead after one person is killed and four injured – latest updates, The Guardian reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
